about.title: About Us
about.intro: We are SZY Innovation Studio. Founded in 2024 by several middle and elementary school students, we are a non-profit technology studio. We focus on coding and are dedicated to developing fun and practical projects through programming to serve the online community. Meanwhile, the studio actively engages in public welfare, continuously carrying out various charitable projects to empower society through technology. We look forward to exchanging ideas and collaborating with like-minded individuals from all walks of life.
